title: Understanding the Law of Large Numbers
text: The law of large numbers is a fundamental concept in probability and statistics. It suggests that as you increase the number of trials or sample size, the sample mean will converge to the expected value or population mean. Think about how this might apply to a random sample drawn with replacement.

title: Sample Mean vs. Population Mean
